<thought>All spectroscopic data (mass 224 Da, formula C16H16O, carbonyl IR, NMR pattern with acetyl methyl singlet, two methylene triplets, and nine aromatic protons) are consistent with the structure p‑phenethylacetophenone, whose SMILES is CC(=O)c1ccc(cc1)CCc2ccccc2.</thought>
